component.name: Cardfile
component.summary: A modern digital card file for your notes

description.p: Cardfile keeps your notes as cards, inspired by the classic Windows 3.1 Cardfile. It is native, fast and private.

ul.li: Word-like editor with headings, lists, checklists, tables, images and attachments
Full-text search, tags, favorites and version history
Export to Markdown, HTML, PDF and JSON
